chapter_note: Chapter 64 is overwhelmingly substrate teaching: a tightly enumerated cosmological doctrine of Adam as the cosmic icon. Two enumeration sequences: (1) THREE GREAT WORKS manifested in Adam (icon of the Exalted One; molding after the Five Sons; teaching/seal of the cosmos with zodiacs, stars, days, years); (2) SEVEN MATTERS concerning Adam's kingship (Illuminator role; drawing of Light; humbling of godhood; seal-character; revelation of all arts; patronage; head/king/lord over creatures). Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — Adam is mapped to the icon of the Ambassador/Third Messenger, to the cosmic structure, to the zodiac houses, etc. NO contemporary institutional reach. Editorial fatigue score is negative (cosmological vocabulary actually decreases in second half due to damage), suggesting this chapter is structurally clean. Only the opening frame "Once again he said to his disciples" is dialogue overlay. The φωστήρ vocabulary in seg 37 refers to Adam's cosmic role, not to Mani-as-Illuminator. Damage ratio 29% is significant but does not obscure the teaching structure.
